tools.name: spec_inventory
tools.title: Spec Inventory
tools.description: Read a bounded, paged inventory of the specifications under the target repository's .specs directory.

tools.name: spec_get_node
tools.title: Spec Get Node
tools.description: Read one specification graph node by qualified canonical ID (for example plugin-distribution:FR-1), with summary or full projection.

tools.name: spec_find_nodes
tools.title: Spec Find Nodes
tools.description: Search specification nodes by spec slug, node kind, canonical ID, or bounded text match; empty filter arrays mean all.

tools.name: spec_get_edges
tools.title: Spec Get Edges
tools.description: List resolved edges incident to one canonical node, optionally aggregated by endpoint pair and type.

tools.name: spec_trace
tools.title: Spec Trace
tools.description: Bounded breadth-first trace from one canonical node across resolved edges with depth and visited limits.

tools.name: spec_diagnostics
tools.title: Spec Diagnostics
tools.description: List stable parser/graph diagnostics filtered by severity, code, spec slug, and repository-relative path.

tools.name: spec_overview
tools.title: Spec Overview
tools.description: Read corpus-level counts, limits, and diagnostic-code/node-kind/edge-type histograms for the target repository.

tools.name: spec_markdown_inventory
tools.title: Spec Markdown Inventory
tools.description: Inventory Markdown headings and GLFM link occurrences (unscoped or heading-focused) to plan safe renames without mutating anything.

tools.name: find_by_tags
tools.title: Find Scenarios By Tags
tools.description: List scenarios whose tag set contains every requested tag.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Spec Tasks
tools.description: List bounded tasks for one specification, with status, phase, requirement, and cursor filters.

tools.name: find_orphans
tools.title: Find Orphaned Spec Nodes
tools.description: Return structural orphan findings for uncovered requirements, tasks, and scenarios.

tools.name: validate_anchor
tools.title: Validate Spec Anchor
tools.description: Validate a canonical node ID or Markdown heading anchor without writing.

tools.name: list_specs
tools.title: List Specifications
tools.description: Enumerate specification slugs present in the current graph.

tools.name: validate_requirement_metadata
tools.title: Validate Requirement Metadata
tools.description: Validate a typed requirement metadata object without writing.

tools.name: policy_query_requirements
tools.title: Query Requirement Policy
tools.description: Filter requirements by verification method, safety class, missing metadata, and delivery.

tools.name: get_archival_proof
tools.title: Get Archival Proof
tools.description: Check whether a specification has live inbound references from other specifications.

tools.name: validate_spec
tools.title: Validate Specification
tools.description: Run the bounded graph validation for one specification without writing.

tools.name: get_spec_status
tools.title: Get Specification Status
tools.description: Read status, counts, or structural coverage for one specification or the corpus.

tools.name: mcp_preflight
tools.title: MCP Preflight
tools.description: Read redacted root, version, lock, and dependency admission facts. Call first to confirm the environment.

tools.name: list_spec_docs
tools.title: List Specification Documents
tools.description: List readable documents and binary attachments under one specification.

tools.name: read_spec_doc
tools.title: Read Specification Document
tools.description: Read one contained specification document, optionally by section or bounded line window.

tools.name: read_attachment
tools.title: Read Specification Attachment
tools.description: Read one contained binary attachment as a bounded base64 payload.

tools.name: get_test_result
tools.title: Get Scenario Test Result
tools.description: Read the last recorded result and freshness fields for one scenario.

tools.name: get_scenario_trace
tools.title: Get Scenario Trace
tools.description: Read one scenario result with its hash-bound runtime trace metadata.

tools.name: propose_patch
tools.title: Propose Specification Patch
tools.description: Build a reviewable multi-operation patch proposal over spec docs; returns a proposalId for apply_proposed_patch.

tools.name: apply_proposed_patch
tools.title: Apply Proposed Specification Patch
tools.description: Apply a reviewed proposal by ID after hash recheck; approval approve is required.

tools.name: amend_requirement
tools.title: Amend Requirement
tools.description: Propose amendment text appended to an FR section.

tools.name: add_acceptance_criterion
tools.title: Add Acceptance Criterion
tools.description: Propose a canonical acceptance criterion appended for one requirement. Use when an FR needs a new testable criterion.

tools.name: add_phase
tools.title: Add Task Phase
tools.description: Propose a task phase heading appended to TASKS.md. Use to structure delivery phases.

tools.name: set_entity_status
tools.title: Set Entity Status
tools.description: Propose a validated task status transition. Use for task progress updates; unknown transitions are rejected.

tools.name: set_spec_status
tools.title: Set Specification Status
tools.description: Propose a specification status line. Use to record spec lifecycle state.

tools.name: set_requirement_metadata
tools.title: Set Requirement Metadata
tools.description: Propose validated typed metadata (verification method, safety class, delivery) for a requirement. Unknown metadata is rejected.

tools.name: delete_spec_doc
tools.title: Delete Specification Document
tools.description: Propose deletion of one contained spec document. Use to remove obsolete docs.

tools.name: rename_spec_doc
tools.title: Rename Specification Document
tools.description: Propose a contained document rename. Refused when inbound Markdown links would break; fix callers first.

tools.name: create_spec
tools.title: Create Specification
tools.description: Propose a full canonical scaffold (15 docs plus feature and schema) for a new spec slug.

tools.name: archive_spec
tools.title: Archive Specification
tools.description: Propose archival of a spec after proving no live inbound references. Use to retire specs; refused otherwise.

tools.name: add_backlog_task
tools.title: Add Backlog Task
tools.description: Propose a traced backlog task. Use for future work items.

tools.name: register_incident_backlog
tools.title: Register Incident Backlog
tools.description: Propose a traced incident task. Use for incident follow-ups.
